about: The name to use in messages when an organisation's record name is not the name it trades under. Each entry is reviewed and sourced; the record name stays unchanged in the database. Read by scripts/messaging/offer_lib.py (display_name). Keyed by company-master organisation_id.

O89f99ae48244.name: Tanzania Experience
O89f99ae48244.reason: The company trades as Tanzania Experience. 'ET Investments Ltd' does not appear on its website (hook research, 23 September 2026), so the first email used a name the recipient would not recognise.

Ob961626c2241.name: Meserani Snake Park
Ob961626c2241.reason: The public knows the business as Meserani Snake Park; its website gives 'Nyamazela Trading Co (T) Ltd.' only as the company name in its contact details (hook research, 25 September 2026).

O82b9889f302c.name: Ngare Sero Mountain Lodge
O82b9889f302c.reason: The website names the business Ngare Sero Mountain Lodge (Ngare Sero Mountain Lodge Ltd.), not 'Mountain Retreat' as on record (hook research, 25 September 2026).

O201e20990155.name: RiverStone Safaris
O201e20990155.reason: The About page calls the company 'Riverstone Safaris Limited' and the site styles it RiverStone; 'RiverStone Africa Safaris' as on record is not the name it uses (hook research, 25 September 2026).
